description: This file declares internal APIs and function prototypes for the Bbhm IpPing Diagnostic Object within the Broadband Home Manager Model. It includes function prototypes for diagnostic state management, processing, operation, sink handling, and task data object (TDO) management, primarily supporting internal implementation aspects of the diagnostic system.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipReset
methods.description: Resets the diagnostic object to its initial state.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the diagnostic object.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetProperty
methods.description: Sets properties of the diagnostic object.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetSrcIpType
methods.description: Gets the source IP type configuration.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetSrcIpType
methods.description: Sets the source IP type configuration.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetDstIpType
methods.description: Gets the destination IP type configuration.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetDstIpType
methods.description: Sets the destination IP type configuration.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetNumPkts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of packets to send.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetNumPkts
methods.description: Sets the number of packets to send.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetPktSize
methods.description: Gets the size of each packet.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetPktSize
methods.description: Sets the size of each packet.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetTimeBetween
methods.description: Gets the time interval between packets.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetTimeBetween
methods.description: Sets the time interval between packets.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetTimeOut
methods.description: Gets the timeout duration for diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetTimeOut
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetControl
methods.description: Gets the control flags or status.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetControl
methods.description: Sets control flags for the diagnostic operation.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetStatus
methods.description: Gets current status of the diagnostic.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetStatus
methods.description: Sets current status of the diagnostic.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetNumIcmpError
methods.description: Gets the number of ICMP errors.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetNumIcmpError
methods.description: Sets the number of ICMP errors.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipGetNumCalculate
methods.description: Gets the number of calculations performed.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetNumCalculate
methods.description: Sets the number of calculations performed.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipAccept
methods.description: Accepts incoming connections for the diagnostic sink.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipRecv
methods.description: Receives data in the diagnostic operation.

methods.name: BbbwDiagipSend
methods.description: Sends data in the diagnostic operation.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipOpen
methods.description: Opens the diagnostic object or session.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipExpire1
methods.description: Handles expiration of the first timer.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipExpire2
methods.description: Handles expiration of the second timer.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipClose
methods.description: Closes the diagnostic session or object.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSetStopTime
methods.description: Sets the stop time parameters for an ongoing diagnostic.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipAddEchoEntry
methods.description: Adds an echo entry for ping diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSinkCreate
methods.description: Creates a sink object for diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSinkGetRecvBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the receive buffer for sink.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSinkGetXsocket
methods.description: Gets the socket associated with the sink.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipSinkSetXsocket
methods.description: Sets the socket for the sink.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipTdoCreate
methods.description: Creates a Task Data Object for diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipTdoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects related to the TDO.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipTdoGetCounter
methods.description: Gets the counter value of TDO.

methods.name: BbhmDiagipTdoSetCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter value of TDO.
